name: empty-isolation-never-published
invariant: An empty isolation setting is never published: an evidence result is published only with its isolation proven by a probe inside the run's own wrapper. A walk run under an empty isolation setting, and a walk whose probe ran in another run's wrapper, are could_not_run/isolation_unproven and never selected; a walk under a loopback setting is published (12 "Content"; 15 E3).
